report.instruction: At the very end of the reply append exactly one <avereth>{JSON}</avereth> with only what THIS reply established in the fiction ({} if nothing). Never report numbers the engine owns (HP, XP, damage, rolls, stats). Alaric travels, moves, pays, gives or accepts only if the player's message chose it (else name the NPC in taken_by/forced_by). Keys, all optional:

keys.place: short sub-location if the scene moved within the location
keys.forced_by: ref of the NPC who moved Alaric against his will
keys.new: [{ref, kind:'npc'|'creature', name?, desc:[words], species?, template?, traits?, band?, cover?}] every newly introduced person/creature
keys.enter: [refs] known people who came into the scene
keys.position: [{who, band:'ENGAGED'|'SHORT'|'MEDIUM'|'LONG', cover?}] distance to Alaric outside combat
keys.aware: [{who, level:'unaware'|'suspicious'|'aware'}] an NPC's awareness of Alaric
keys.concealed: [refs] who is now unseen by the others (e.g. 'pc'); [] when nobody is
keys.facts: [{s, p, o, vis?:'secret', because?}] new world facts; p 'status' for alive/dead/destroyed/occupied...
keys.learn: [{who, s, p, o, how:'witnessed'|'told'|'rumor'|'inferred', from?}] something a character now knows
keys.believe: [{who, s, p, o, from?}] a belief that may be false
keys.attitude: [{who, toward?, delta:-50..50, why}] relationship change (toward defaults to Alaric)
keys.memory: [{text, who:[refs], witnesses?:[refs], public?:true, imp:1-10}] a moment worth remembering; who took part, witnesses saw it, public = everyone who noticed
keys.items: [{item, qty, from?, to?, taken_by?, why}] physical hand-overs
keys.coin: [{who, cp, taken_by?, why}] coin in Copper (negative = paid)
keys.recover: [{who?, hp?, mp?, sta?, why}] rest/healing/meals outside combat (amount by the narrative; never during combat)
keys.quests: [{title, status:'offered'|'active'|'completed'|'failed', giver?, note?, level?, type?:'minor'|'standard'|'dangerous'|'major'}] (level/type when offered: they fix the Quest XP)
keys.combat: {by, target?} or a list: ONLY NPCs/creatures committing to an attack right now (never resolve it)
keys.check: {what, stat, actor, opposition, actor_mods?:[pct], opp_mods?:[pct], success} only when the CHECK DIE was used

outcome_rules: Narrate every RESOLVED line exactly once and in order; do not add hits, misses, projectiles, wounds, deaths, movement or combatants.
Numbers stay in the engine; prose may mention them only as the engine states them.
A defeated combatant (HP 0) is dead unless the engine says otherwise; a combatant with HP above 0 can still act.
Stop at Alaric's next decision boundary; never choose his next action.
changes_from_v2_3: Added ENGINE AUTHORITY section (engine is the source of truth; narrate resolved outcomes exactly; no rolling; CHECK DIE for Core #7 checks; stop at commitment for unresolved attacks; tracker mirrors engine; NPC knowledge cards are complete; retrieved lines are narrator knowledge; append the <avereth> fact report).
COMBAT NARRATIVE FOCUS: mechanics owned by the Avereth Engine.
PERSISTENCE: values carried by the Avereth Engine (tracker only without the engine).
OUTPUT-FORMAT OWNERSHIP: the hidden <avereth> fact report is the only Avereth-owned output; its key format is given in every engine block (single source: narrator.json report).
FINAL SANDBOX CHECK items 11 (narration matches RESOLVED block) and 12 (fact report present).
All behaviour rules of v2.3 (agency, thought firewall, decision boundaries, PC state delta, world indifference, knowledge boundaries, canon, combat focus) are unchanged.
